rootCauseProgress.finding: The systemic loop mechanism is now more specific: historical authority survived in three distinct mutation planes—provider writes, canonical/evidence state writes, and source/product writes. Several read-only and retired workflows are correctly inert, but residual enabled requests can still revive old source/state writers unless F1 tombstones them and F2 requires the frozen continuity authority before any execution.
rootCauseProgress.fixModel: Finish exhaustive F0 inventory; atomically inertize every residual historical provider/source/state mutation authority in F1; bind all retained executors to master-plan + continuity-lock + consumed-ledger authority in F2; only then revalidate and execute G2-B under a new explicit one-shot authorization.
